create.title: Smooth stationary support flatness removes the outer dual-difference edge
create.statement_tex: Let J=sqrt(X), Q=J^(2/5), T=J^(3/5), B=C/T, and J^(13/18)<C<=J^(3/4). Fix a compatible transition-flattened smooth nonaxial M1 principal component, local class kappa in {1/4,1/2,1}, alias, and endpoint orientation from M9-M1-centred-dual-difference-small-shift-bound. Let N_b^-,N_b^+ be the extreme integer endpoints of the active stationary support of the compact smooth principal Fourier main, Delta_b=N_b^+-N_b^- asymp Q^2, D_0=floor(J^(17/30)), and E_*=floor(Q^2J^(-1/20))=floor(J^(3/4)). The accepted normalized smooth hierarchy through order 3 transfers endpoint flatness under the saddle map: when 0<=Delta_b-|d|<=E_*, the two principal symbols lie at opposite support endpoints and their product has the factor ((Delta_b-|d|+1)/Q^2)^6. Exact residue L1 mass then gives the complete main-main edge bound <<_epsilon X^epsilon H^2(BE_*+E_*^2)(E_*/Q^2)^6<<X^epsilon J^(13/10), where H=C sqrt(T)/J. Independently, the complete entry/exit, stationary-remainder, wrong-sign, and nonstationary terms summed over all integer differences are <<_epsilon X^epsilon(B^2HQ^2+B^3)<<X^epsilon J^(23/20). Hence every |d|>=Delta_b-E_* is target-safe, including negative d, all three classes, reflected orientations, nonzero d congruent 0 mod M, Ramanujan terms, prime-power gcd modes, and the no-main-overlap exterior. The exact first-band smooth-principal survivor is M^(-2)sum_(b asymp B)sum_(D_0<|d|<Delta_b-E_*)sum_n(S(n+d,K;M)conj(S(n,K;M))-c_M(d))I_b(n+d)conj(I_b(n)). The proof preserves the inherited physical Q^(-5/24) row estimate for this interior survivor. No whole-offset B-power, conductor extension, raw transition or axial estimate, cone-edge estimate, full M9-M1, M9, or exponent is proved.
create.next_action: Estimate the exact interior survivor D_0<|d|<Delta_b-E_* through the continuously twisted-row ambiguity form or the weighted four-Kloosterman A-process off-diagonal, retaining prime-power modes and the physical Q^(-5/12) energy factor.

update.statement_tex: Let J=sqrt(X), Q=J^(2/5), T=J^(3/5), and J^(13/18)<C<=J. In the first band J^(13/18)<C<=J^(3/4), the exact transition error and axes are separately target-safe. For each fixed smooth nonaxial principal component, the three arithmetic classes reduce to the centred Kloosterman-product dual correlation. The complete same-residue mode, literal d=0, every 0<|d|<=D_0=floor(J^(17/30)), and now the complete outer support-difference range |d|>=Delta_b-E_* are target-safe, where Delta_b asymp Q^2 is the actual stationary-support diameter and E_*=floor(Q^2J^(-1/20)). The two deletions include both signs, nonzero multiples d congruent 0 mod M, Ramanujan terms, gcd modes, entry/exit, stationary errors, and wrong-sign tails. Thus the first-band principal survivor is exactly Y_int=M^(-2)sum_(b asymp B)sum_(D_0<|d|<Delta_b-E_*)sum_n(S(n+d,K;M)conj(S(n,K;M))-c_M(d))I_b(n+d)conj(I_b(n)), with target <<_epsilon X^epsilon J^2/T. No estimate for Y_int is proved. On J^(3/4)<C<=J, the principal main, transition error, and axes all require signed control. This proves no conductor extension, cone edge, full M9-M1, M9, or exponent.
update.next_action: Attack the exact interior weighted four-Kloosterman/continuously twisted-row correlation in J^(13/18)<C<=J^(3/4), then return to C>J^(3/4), where transitions and axes also remain open.
The small differences and the outer stationary-support edge are target-safe. Estimate the exact middle survivor recorded in M9-M1-centred-dual-difference-support-edge-bound.
The literal d=0, small nonzero differences, and outer stationary-support differences are target-safe. Estimate the remaining middle difference correlation.
Close the middle first-band correlation D_0<|d|<Delta_b-E_*, then treat C>J^(3/4), cone edges, remaining radial sectors, and endpoint uniformity.

reject.reason: The exact continuously shifted physical-row identity preserves Q^(-5/12), but Fourier projection costs ||K_w||_1>=1 for any unit plateau and returns the prior C^3/(TQ^(5/12)) capacity. A new signed theta,b,residue correlation is required.
Zero mean removes only the zero residue frequency. Exact Parseval trades the arithmetic modes for an unresolved stationary ambiguity energy, whose trivial norm cancels the apparent saving.

The literal d-A-process has compulsory Fejer prefactors and a diagonal. Although the diagonal is target-safe, the off-diagonal is a weighted four-Kloosterman correlation; modulus self-return shifts, prime-power modes, and perfect-power phase resonances cannot be omitted.

The support-edge proof uses the compact C-infinity neighbor-independent principal cutoff. The separately owned raw Round-81 Farey transition has different variation and is not covered by endpoint flatness.

no_change.reason: The outer large-difference edge is removed, but the middle first-band correlation, C>J^(3/4), cone edges, remaining radial sectors, and endpoint uniformity remain open.
Round 85 concerns only the M1 transition-flattened smooth-principal upper-conductor correlation.
Both M9-M1 and M9-M2 remain open.
The round proves a strict M1 range deletion but no new global Gauss-circle exponent.

round_assessment.reason: Round 85 proves no conductor or exponent improvement, but the actual compact stationary symbol removes an outer difference collar of width J^(3/4), with all-d error terms independently re-audited. It strictly narrows the exact first-band survivor and identifies the continuously twisted-row/four-Kloosterman interior correlation as the next unsupported interface.
